description: Counts before and after an operator. A count after an operator multiplies the count before it.

cases.description: 0 after a digit extends the count instead of moving to the first column.
3d: the operator keeps the count typed before it.

vscodevim.deviation: Measured: on 2026-10-16, in VS Code 1.134.0 and 1.141.0 with VSCodeVim 1.32.4 and its default settings (harness of issue #11; spike/s2/data/fixture-reader-v2), VSCodeVim held d in its remap buffer as a prefix of its default surround mapping ds (vim.surround is on by default) and had not started the d operator 100 ms after the key, in 30 of 30 trials at 10, 30 and 60 ms injected key delay. It started the operator when vim.timeout ran out.

cases.description: d3: a count after the operator applies to the motion.

cases.description: 2d3: the count before the operator and the count after it multiply, so 2d3w deletes six words.
